apps.name: Logi MX Ink Experience
apps.description: Logitech's free demo app for writing, sketching and drawing in 2D and 3D.

apps.name: Gravity Sketch
apps.description: 3D design and sketching tool for product and concept design, with collaboration.
apps.notes: Developer patch notes GS 6.3.7 (2024-10-01): 'Quest 2 and Quest 3 support for Logitech MX Ink Stylus'. Also on Logitech's list. A separate PC VR (Rift) store listing exists: https://www.meta.com/experiences/pcvr/gravity-sketch/1018110521596029/

apps.name: ShapesXR
apps.description: Tool for prototyping 3D products and XR apps, alone or with a team.
apps.notes: Evidence is Logitech's launch blog; no developer-side MX Ink announcement found.

apps.name: Arkio
apps.description: Collaborative 3D design tool for architecture and building design.
apps.notes: Arkio 1.9 release blog (2024-10-01): 'Bringing the pen and paper feel to Arkio with Logitech's MX Ink stylus'.

apps.name: Adobe Substance 3D Modeler
apps.description: 3D sculpting and modelling app that works on desktop and in VR.
apps.notes: PC VR only (Quest via Link/Air Link); no Meta Horizon Store listing found. Steam announcement 2024-09-24: 'Modeler now supports the Logitech MX Ink 6 DOF Pen in VR mode'. adobe.com returns 403 to scripted fetch (URL taken from search results).
apps.note: Runs on a PC. Use Quest Link or Air Link.

apps.name: Figmin XR
apps.description: Mixed reality app for creating, collecting and playing with 3D content in your room.
apps.notes: Store description (mirrored on QuestStoreDB) lists 'Logitech MXInk support'.

apps.name: Gesture VR
apps.description: Figure drawing studio with posed 3D models, lighting controls and timed sessions.
apps.notes: Evidence is Logitech's launch blog; no developer-side MX Ink announcement found. Store rating: Mature (nudity).
apps.note: Rated Mature on the Meta store (figure drawing with nudity).

apps.name: Painting VR
apps.description: Virtual painter's studio with realistic brushes, paint mixing and canvases.
apps.notes: Evidence is Logitech's launch blog; no developer-side MX Ink announcement found. paintingvr.com is a parked domain, not the official site.

apps.name: Vermillion
apps.description: Oil painting simulator with paint-by-numbers, layers and multiplayer.
apps.notes: Developer site: 'Vermillion includes full support for the Logitech MX Ink stylus'. Store description: 'Logitech MX Ink fully supported'.

apps.name: Open Brush
apps.description: Free, open-source 3D painting app, the community successor to Tilt Brush.
apps.notes: v2.10 release notes: 'Open Brush now supports the pressure-sensitive Logitech MX Ink stylus on compatible Meta Quest headsets.' A PC VR (Rift) listing also exists: https://www.meta.com/experiences/pcvr/open-brush/5227489953989768/

apps.name: THRASHER
apps.description: Arcade rhythm-action game where you guide a space eel through alien worlds.
apps.notes: Developer post (2024-09-25): 'New THRASHER Update with MX Ink Stylus Support and Improved Localization'.

apps.name: Hololight Stream
apps.description: Enterprise tool for reviewing large CAD models, streamed from a PC or server.
apps.notes: Developer announced MX Ink support in the 2024.0.1.0 service update (2024-10-21): https://hololight.com/news/hololight-space-2024-0-1-0-service-update. Docs (Hololight Space 2026.0.0): MX Ink supported on Meta Quest 3 and 3S only. The old 'Hololight Space' Quest client (https://www.meta.com/experiences/hololight-space/7244433112274057/) is marked deprecated; its store text says to use Hololight Stream to connect, so storeUrl points to Hololight Stream (free client; needs an enterprise Hololight Space server/licence). Content is streamed from a PC/server/cloud.
apps.note: Quest 3 and 3S only. Replaces the older Hololight Space app.

apps.name: Fundamental Surgery
apps.description: Surgical training simulator for practising procedures in VR, sold to institutions.
apps.notes: Enterprise product, not on the Meta Horizon Store. A FundamentalVR press release (Aug 2024) on integrating MX Ink is quoted in search results but no fetchable copy was found; evidence is Logitech's list. Platform not independently verified.
apps.note: Not on the public Meta store. Contact the developer.

apps.name: Osso VR
apps.description: Surgical and procedural skills training platform for healthcare professionals.
apps.notes: Enterprise product (Osso Enterprise), not on the public Meta Horizon Store (Osso Nurse Training is listed, but MX Ink support there is unconfirmed). Evidence is Logitech's list and UploadVR; no Osso announcement found.
apps.note: Not on the public Meta store. Contact the developer.

apps.name: Elucis
apps.description: Medical platform for building 3D anatomical models from patient scans.
apps.notes: Logitech blog: 'MX Ink also brings critical precision to surgery planning using Elucis by Realize Medical.' UploadVR describes it as a PC VR app used over Quest Link/Air Link. No store listing found. Realize Medical's earlier Logitech partnership (3dprint.com, 2020) concerns the older Logitech VR Ink, not MX Ink.
apps.note: Not on the public Meta store. Contact the developer.

apps.name: Immersed
apps.description: Virtual office app that mirrors your computer screens as multiple virtual monitors.
apps.notes: Only source is UploadVR's launch-day list (2024-09-25). Not on Logitech's list; no developer announcement found.

apps.name: Jigsaw Night
apps.description: Social jigsaw puzzle game in VR or mixed reality, with co-located multiplayer.
apps.notes: UploadVR (2025-11-11) shows a setting for MX Ink in the dominant hand plus hand tracking in the other. Early Access. No developer announcement found.
